description: Fastenal began as a partnership in 1967 and was incorporated under the laws of Minnesota in 1968, opening its first branch in 1967 in Winona, Minnesota. It began with a marketing strategy of supplying threaded fasteners to customers through a branch network in small, medium and, in subsequent years, large cities, and over time how and where it engages customers has expanded and evolved. Today it sells a broader range of industrial and construction supplies spanning more than nine major product lines through a global network of locations utilizing diverse technologies such as vending devices, bin stock devices and eBusiness, with the large majority of its transactions being business-to-business, and at the end of 2025 it had 1,595 branch locations in 25 countries.
